protocol.exits: Shared PCT2/4 or reference ATR2/4; UTC4-day timed exits, fees/risk/maxnotional unchanged; simple baselines use existing signal functions but shared protective exits, not their native exits.
protocol.holdout: No extra trading PnL calculated on2025 if no locked finalist. Buy-and-hold2025 preregistered separate risk reference; never used for selection.
protocol.random_scope: Per continuous segment and period, exactly matched eligible reference signal count; unbiased random side. Ex-post frequency-conditioned comparator, NOT live tradable strategy or fully matched position duration.
protocol.walk_forward: Frozen standalone-pattern subset (NONE context only, both stop policies), train2020->test2021, train2020-21->test2022, train2020-22->test2023, train2020-23->test2024. Pick at most one numerical case per timeframe using prior train only, no retuning. Selection may fail inference gates; reported descriptive only.

independent_audit.method: Independent exact Fraction adverse fills, Decimal ceil fees, next-open/touch/side/risk/overlap checks and independently reconstructed cash/liquidation equity/drawdown. Conditional gap ledgers checked as conditional, not asserted investable.

independent_control_audit.scope: All delivered matched random/simple baseline and executed walk-forward test portfolios; training-selection portfolios use engine internal guards, not included in this independent count. Buy-hold is separately risk-non-equivalent.

metric_definitions.sample_note: At least 20 trades required for numerical ranking; passing threshold is not statistical proof of profitability.
metric_definitions.sharpe_assumptions: UTC full-day liquidation-equity returns; sample stdev; sqrt(365), crypto 24/7, zero risk-free rate. Undefined with <20 trades, <30 daily returns, nonpositive equity or zero variance.

protocol.gap_policy: Reset 250-bar warmup after every gap. Unresolved positions censored with known entry fee restored ONLY in conditional closed-trade ledger; any censored period fails selection. No execution across a gap.
protocol.holdout_status: 2025 ALREADY OBSERVED in six-year report: repeated locked confirmation, NOT untouched blind holdout. HOLDOUT_PASSED/PAPER_ONLY_ELIGIBLE disabled.
protocol.multiplicity: Bonferroni over entire 810-hypothesis search, not only profitable survivors. 19999 replicates yield minimum empirical p=1/20000, resolving .05/810. Block stationarity assumptions remain limitations, not a profitability proof.
protocol.neutral_policy: Non-directional detector requires causal EMA20/50 direction; no direction means no entry. This is an explicit directional hypothesis, not a neutral-pattern forecast.
protocol.ranking: Net profit descending among fully observed runs; sample size, block uncertainty, drawdown and multiplicity gates applied separately. No ranking implies profitability.
protocol.time_exit: Next open after a closed candle ending at UTC 4-day epoch boundary; maximum 4 days.
